Nina (PM): Quick handoff: we need a lightweight DP invite + a clear SLA for incoming asks. Goal: reduce back-and-forth and surface scope/infra needs early.
Lena (ProdOps): Can do. What are the non-negotiables we must capture in the initial reply?
Nina (PM): Must-haves: short problem pitch, time commitment, data access level (none/hosted/dedicated), screener link, NDA link, incentives. Also a field for 'hard blocker' (yes/no).
Raj (Eng): For infra please include expected traffic pattern (qps, typical tokens) and any required region/hardware. If they check "dedicated", we route to the Dedicated team immediately.
Tyler (Sales): Also add a quick checkbox: "Can demo in <2 weeks>" — Sales needs to know which partners we can onboard fast.
Maya (Legal): NDA is fine but flag: if they request on-prem or HSM we need a brief SOW review. Add "legal review required" tag for those.
Lena (ProdOps): Draft invite below (keeping it short). Pls comment: ```Hi {name}, Redwood is running a private test of an inference flow optimized for latency and cost. Commitment: ~3 sessions (30m) over 4	6 weeks. Tell us: use case summary, qps & token estimate, infra preference (hosted/dedicated/private), and path to demo in 2 weeks? Screener: https://go.redwood/dp-screener NDA: https://go.redwood/nda Stipend: $400. Reply to accept or ask Qs.```
Nina (PM): Nice. Add one line: "we measure p50/p95, tokens/request, and subjective quality" so partners know evaluation focus.
Lena (ProdOps): Added. New snippet in Confluence.
bp-bot: Channel created: #dp-invite-2026 0 posting Confluence: https://go.redwood/confluence/dp-invite-runbook
Raj (Eng): SLA proposal: ProdOps initial ack <24h, Eng triage for infra blockers <48h, PM decision on scope/feature asks <72h. For Dedicated requests we escalate to Dedicated-ops within 12h of triage.
Maya (Legal): Legal review targets: standard NDA <48h, SOW/HSM requests 5 business days.
Tyler (Sales): Can we add "priority label" for partners who are existing enterprise customers? They get faster onboarding.
Nina (PM): Yes: priority label => 12h ack and assigned Solutions engineer. Documented in the runbook.
Raj (Eng): Operational note: if our hosted test fails to meet p50 target we have an automated fallback flow to a smaller quantized model. Add rollback steps to the runbook.
Lena (ProdOps): I'll add a tiny triage matrix with columns: "partner type, infra need, legal flag, demo window, priority" and an owner column.
Nina (PM): Launch criteria (initial cohort): 4 partners accepted and engaged, hosted p50 <250ms on partner-specific test, no P0 incidents after cohort start for 7 days, and a documented post-cohort action list.
Tyler (Sales): Sounds good. I'll funnel candidate list into #dp-invite-2026 starting tomorrow.
Maya (Legal): One more: include a line in the invite re: data handling: "we will not store customer inputs beyond ephemeral logs for debugging; opt-out available." Legal likes that.
Lena (ProdOps): Included. I'll post final checklist in 45m and tag assignees: steward: @Lena, backup: @Raj.
Raj (Eng): Quick dev snippet for partners who want to smoke test locally: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"latency test"}'```
Nina (PM): Great. After the first three responses we'll do a 1:1 sync to ensure the screening captures useful signals. Thanks everyone.
Lena (ProdOps): Closing loop: final invite + SLA + triage matrix posted: https://go.redwood/confluence/dp-invite-runbook :white_check_mark:
Nina (PM): Perfect, I'll update the roadmap notes to reflect DP timeline and acceptance criteria.
